steps.text: Soil can be too acidic or too basic for crops. Farmers fix it with neutralisation: Acid + Base → Salt + Water (neutral).
Look at the pH scale: 0–6 is acidic, 7 is neutral, and 8–14 is basic. Crops grow best near neutral.
Explore the controls to treat the soil — add a base to acidic soil (or an acid to basic soil) to bring the pH toward 7.
Watch the pH move to the neutral zone. Balanced soil means healthy crops — that's chemistry helping farmers!
